input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21 meets our preferred position in full. The cap is expressly mutual and set at the greater of Fees "paid or payable" by Customer in the twelve months preceding the event and USD 1,000,000 (21.1). Section 21.2 is a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, and it helpfully confirms that data restoration, replacement services, notification and incident-response costs are direct damages. Section 21.3 places outside the cap exactly the carve-outs we require — breach of confidentiality, data-protection or security obligations, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, and infringement of the other Party's IP — and confirms Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees is not "damages" subject to the cap. Section 21.4 preserves each cap and exclusion independently and on failure of an exclusive remedy, and 18.2 confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. The "Fees" definition (1.5) covers recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the cap base is substantive (not an illusory set-up fee); it excludes a one-time implementation charge, which is immaterial given the USD 1,000,000 floor. No hidden cap or one-sided liability language appears in the warranty or indemnity provisions. No redline required.
